::: {.fun .mint}
Grace joined the lab in August 2022, the first official member of the dela Cerna lab when it opened at Georgia Southern, as an undergraduate researcher. She obtained her **BS in Biochemistry** in 2024 and her **MS in Applied Physical Sciences** in 2025. As a graduate student, Grace was recognized by a Graduate Research Achievement Award by the **College of Science and Mathematics** and a **Jack N. Averitt Award for Contributions and Achievements in Research**. She is currently a Research Assistant in the lab and plans to pursue a PhD in Biomedical Sciences in the near future.
:::
